newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gillette price target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gillette price target raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Carol Warner said she was raising her 12-month price target for Gillette Co's stock to $95 from $90 based on the company's strong fourth-quarter results.

-- "Gillette's impressive market shares, top-line growth, margin expansion and earnings growth, combined with exciting new products and markets, are the key resons why it is one of our top picks for 1997. Very few companies consistently put up this type of strong, well-balanced growth," Warner said.
-- The analyst said the company was in a good position to keep posting strong earnings and should rectify problems with recently acquired Duracell International Inc in 1997.
-- Warner maintained her 1997 earnings estimate of $2.60 per share.
-- Gillette shares climbed 1/2 to 82 in early afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
